sql: SELECT TOP 10 ps.PaymentCode AS paymentCode, ps.PaymentName AS paymentName, COALESCE(pps.PaymentDisplayName, ps.PaymentDisplayName) AS displayName FROM dbo.ZnodePaymentSetting ps INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePaymentType pt ON pt.PaymentTypeId = ps.PaymentTypeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalPaymentSetting pps ON pps.PaymentSettingId = ps.PaymentSettingId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pps.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState pub ON pub.PublishStateId = pps.PublishStateId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND pt.Name = @gatewayType AND pt.Code = @paymentTypeCode AND pt.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.IsActive = @isActive AND pps.IsUsedForWebStorePayment = @isActive AND pub.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND (@preferred IS NULL OR ps.PaymentCode = @preferred) ORDER BY ps.PaymentSettingId
